body:
lauren.p: Quick heads-up — NimbleAccel (HW partner) just notified us they are changing their gateway API surface. They plan to flip the v1 endpoint behavior on 2026-05-15. They want marketplace images and partner integrations to be forward-compatible. Can we coordinate a compatibility plan?

mike.dev: High-level — we can do a lightweight translation shim in the marketplace image that maps old headers + payload to the new shape. Low risk.

sanjay: Agreed. Two options: 1) runtime shim in the gateway image (fast), or 2) upstream SDK patch to handle both shapes (broader). I prefer shim + opt-in SDK fallback.

taylor.pm: Timeline constraints: partner wants a validated path in Q2. We need partner-facing notice, migration guide, and SDK compatibility. Can we commit dates?

anna.docs: I can draft migration guide and FAQ. Need concrete request examples and curl samples + expected responses. Also want a sample test harness for partners.

helen.nimble: From NimbleAccel: primary change — header X-Accel-Version removed in favor of X-NA-Version and body field "model_ref" moved under "meta". We will keep old behavior for 90 days post-cutover, but recommend partners migrate early. We'll share spec today.

mike.dev: Sample translation logic (we can include in shim):
```
if (headers["X-Accel-Version"]) {
  headers["X-NA-Version"] = headers["X-Accel-Version"];
}
if (body.model_id) {
  body.meta = body.meta || {};
  body.meta.model_ref = body.model_id;
  delete body.model_id;
}
```
Can push to marketplace image as patch.

lauren.p: Partner asks: 1) compatibility guarantee for marketplace images, 2) SDK deprecation timeline published, 3) migration docs + sample tests. I'll own partner notification.

taylor.pm: Proposed public schedule:
- 2026-03-28: partner notice + internal heads-up
- 2026-04-10: runtime shim in marketplace image + internal QA
- 2026-04-20: migration guide + test harness published
- 2026-04-25: SDK patch release (minor version) with opt-in fallback
- 2026-05-15: NimbleAccel flips default; we continue shim for 90 days as compatibility tier
- 2026-08-13: hard deprecation of shim (90 days after flip)
Is that realistic?

sanjay: Dates look ok. Need SRE and eng-infra signoff for marketplace rollout and canary policy. I'll file a rollout ticket.

anna.docs: Will placeholder the guide now, will need API examples (old vs new). Can anyone paste the spec snippet when available?

helen.nimble: Uploading spec to partner share (link: https://nimble/partner-spec/v2) — includes exact header + payload diffs and test vectors.

mike.dev: CI tests: add contract test that sends old payload -> expect new payload accepted. We'll add to partner-integ pipeline and marketplace image build.

lauren.p: Action items:
- lauren.p: send partner notice + internal customer success alert by 2026-03-28
- sanjay: create rollout ticket + infra checklist by 2026-03-31 (owns shim deploy)
- mike.dev: implement shim + unit tests by 2026-04-10; add contract test to partner pipeline by 2026-04-12
- anna.docs: draft migration guide + sample curl + test harness README by 2026-04-20
- taylor.pm: coordinate marketplace listing + partner announcement timeline by 2026-04-30

mike.dev: small SDK note — we'll add an opt-in env var REDWOOD_NA_COMPAT=true to enable fallback in hosted SDKs for customers who can't update immediately. We'll release as patch (1.2.3) and mark deprecated after 45 days.

helen.nimble: That env var approach is fine for enterprise partners. We'll promote migration internally.

anna.docs: Example migration snippet I'll publish: 
```bash
# old request
curl -H "X-Accel-Version: 1" -d '{"model_id":"rwd-1","input":"hi"}' https://inference.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# new request
curl -H "X-NA-Version: 1" -d '{"meta":{"model_ref":"rwd-1"},"input":"hi"}' https://inference.redwood.ai/v2/generate
```

mike.dev: Canary plan: 5% of traffic to shimmed images in staging -> 10% in limited marketplace -> full after 48h of no regression. We'll include latency probes.

lauren.p: Please add a short partner-facing blurb for the notice: "We will provide a compatibility gateway in marketplace images to bridge the v1->v2 NimbleAccel gateway change; please follow the migration guide for long-term upgrade." I'll send once docs are ready.

deploy-bot: marketplace-image/compat-shim deployed to canary (sha: ab12cd3) at 2026-04-10T14:03:12Z :rocket:

mike.dev: Patch ready for review — PR #3512 with shim + tests. Want reviews from @sanjay and @anna.docs on test vectors.

sanjay: Reviewing now. Also adding perf guard to ensure shim path < +5ms p50.

anna.docs: I'll sync test vectors from Nimble spec and iterate on docs after CI green.

lauren.p: Great — once PR merges I'll circulate the partner notice draft and the marketplace schedule. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
